clips.title: The story
paras: The Savage Coast is the rugged western shoreline of northern Stranglethorn Vale, stretching from the southern border of Westfall down toward Grom'gol Base Camp. Prowled by river crocolisks, shore basilisks, and hostile troll tribes, the strand earns its brutal name with every tide.

Running from the cliffs bordering Westfall south toward Grom'gol Base Camp, the Savage Coast marks the perilous western edge of northern Stranglethorn Vale. The sandy banks offer little hospitality: snapjaws, crocolisks, and stonestalkers roam freely among the tide pools and drift logs. Just inland lie territorial jungle troll encampments, making any casual walk along the beach a fight for survival. Offshore, the waters dip toward the submerged dangers of the Vile Reef, ensuring that danger lurks both on the sand and under the waves.
